'''FK Srem''' ({{Lang-sr-Cyrl|ФК Срем}}) is a [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Sremska Mitrovica]], [[Vojvodina]], [[Serbia]]. They most recently competed in the Sremska Mitrovica City League, the 7th tier of the [[Serbian football league system|national league system]]."}}
